title: Niveles de ánima, victoria y caídos
description: Ánima levels by EXP (src/levels.ts, docs/animas/README.md § Levels) in a real fight of Uri's tower: Matemágico's new skills, Análisis Parálisis (the party's stats rising, with the new stat animation) and Cardioide (a cure drawn as a cardioid of light); Aitor falling and staying down where he fell; and the victory screen, each ánima that took part with its EXP bar filling and the level it reaches, with what it learns.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.fightReady = () => document.querySelector('#hud[data-battle]') && window.gerard.battleUI.fight?.phase === 'player' && !window.gerard.battleUI.fight.busy && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.turnOf = id => window.fightReady() && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; { const set = window.gerard.game.setBattle; window.gerard.game.setBattle = (state, ...rest) => { window.fightState = state; return set(state, ...rest); }; }
window.fightState.foes.forEach(f => { f.maxHp = f.hp = 999; }); window.gerard.battleUI.setAnimas(['matemagico', 'papagato'], { matemagico: 3, papagato: 1 }); window.gerard.battleUI.refresh()

steps.caption: Matemágico at level 3: Foc Binari, Análisis Parálisis and Cardioide
Análisis Parálisis: Fuerza and Magia up for the whole party, with the new stat animation (fine bars, two circles, light rising)

steps.eval: { const s = window.fightState, a = s.allies.find(x => x.id === 'aitor'), g = s.allies.find(x => x.id === 'gerard'); a.hp = Math.round(a.maxHp * .35); g.secondary = g.maxSecondary; window.gerard.battleUI.refresh(); }

steps.caption: Cardioide is aimed at the party: only the hurt one standing can be picked
Cardioide: a cardioid of green light under Aitor and the cure rising, «+PV»

steps.eval: { const s = window.fightState; s.allies.find(x => x.id === 'aitor').hp = 0; window.gerard.game.setBattle(s); window.gerard.battleUI.refresh(); }

steps.caption: Aitor falls: he tips onto his side and stays there, eyes shut, no puff of smoke
Aitor stays lying where he fell (a future skill can bring him back up)
Victory: each ánima that took part, who wore it, its EXP bar filling, «¡NIVEL 2!» and what it learns
The victory screen once the bars have filled: Matemágico and Papagato reach level 2
